notes: Every screen is new. Home is one card: today's workout with each lift's target and Start, a protein tile, the weigh-in, what's due, your streaks. Workout walks you through one lift and one set at a time with a rest clock that keeps running on every tab and buzzes at zero; All lifts shows the whole session (Full, 45 or 30 minutes, drag to reorder) and the day name swaps days. Food is one box (type, talk or snap a photo) with chips for the foods you log most. Progress is three numbers, your weight trend, your main lifts, sets by muscle and photos, with charts, check-in forms, milestones and settings behind the gear. Pick your own accent color. All your data stays as it is. 3.3.1: the cycle-notes tap is back on Home. 3.3.2: on the week sheet, tap a day then tap where it goes, or hold and drag; swaps are for this week only, with a warning when two hard days would touch and an Undo.
knowledgeNotes: New training knowledge: a plan-building playbook (weekly sets by goal, effort, progression, deload ranges), a recommendation guide (fixes and options for common feedback), and an exercise A to Z of extra exercises for each muscle group. Your coach uses it quietly when you ask for a change. Say "turn on plan review" if you want it to suggest plan updates.
